title: pentossaea coriacea
intro: Pentossaea coriacea, commonly known as the "Gamboge", is a tropical plant species native to Southeast Asia. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pentossaea coriacea include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimalarial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of the plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and xanthones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
